description: Centralized AI tool configuration hub — single source of truth for prompts, contexts, commands, rules, skills, agents, and provider adapters across AI coding tools.

validated_local_contracts.note: Claude settings stay hand-managed, but these access fields are validated as part of the adapter contract.

auto_discovery.antigravity_skills: Symlinked to ~/.gemini/skills/ and ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/plugins/hub/skills/ — both point to ~/.agents/skills/.
auto_discovery.pi_skills: Auto-discovers from ~/.agents/skills/ — no symlink needed. Prompt templates wired via settings prompts array (~/.agents/commands).

mcp.contract: Tool-native MCP support; hub policy stays in commands/rules

session_continuity.contract: Shared continuity helpers write project-local runtime state and project-local handoffs

settings.contract: ~/.claude/settings.json remains local config but must preserve required ~/.agents access fields while keeping hook, statusline, and plugin ownership local

commands.contract: No hub-managed Codex-native command bridge in this repo

hooks.contract: ~/.codex/hooks.json registers OMX native hooks plus hub shell safety hooks

mcp.contract: Tool-native MCP configured outside the hub

session_continuity.contract: Shared continuity helpers write project-local runtime state and project-local handoffs

skills.contract: ~/.config/opencode/skills -> ~/.agents/skills + hub skills registered by sync.sh gen-opencode-skills

hooks.contract: OpenCode upstream supports plugin event hooks, but this repo does not manage an OpenCode hook bridge yet

mcp.contract: Tool-native MCP support when configured by the operator

session_continuity.contract: Shared continuity helpers write project-local runtime state and project-local handoffs

memory.contract: No shared memory bridge script; each ZLI uses its native memory surface

commands.contract: Generated TOML commands from ~/.agents/commands via sync.sh gen-antigravity-commands with Gemini path rewriting

agents.contract: Generated from ~/.agents/agents via sync.sh gen-antigravity-agents into Gemini-compatible agent frontmatter

hooks.contract: Gemini CLI upstream supports extensions and hook-like automation surfaces, but this repo does not manage an Antigravity hook bridge yet

mcp.contract: Gemini CLI upstream supports MCP, but this repo does not manage an Antigravity MCP contract yet

session_continuity.contract: Shared continuity helpers write project-local runtime state and project-local handoffs

memory.contract: No shared memory bridge script; each ZLI uses its native memory surface

generated.note: OpenCode agents are generated from hub agent markdown into OpenCode-compatible frontmatter.
Hub-local skills are registered into .skill-lock.json so the OpenCode skill() tool can discover them. Run after adding new skills to skills/.

Antigravity requires .toml (description + prompt fields). Hub stores commands as .md with YAML frontmatter. Run 'sync.sh gen-antigravity-commands' or 'sync.sh migrate' to regenerate after hub command changes.
Antigravity agents are generated from the hub agent definitions into Gemini-compatible agent files with translated frontmatter and Gemini-native tool names.
